title: Mover Quote Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mover:quote
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by vendor_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when mover quote data has stopped arriving for a given mover.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per mover and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your mover quote feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
